### Summary

I had installed uv on Windows using the standard installer, and wanted to move to installing with WinGet. I followed https://docs.astral.sh/uv/getting-started/installation/#uninstallation to uninstall.

After installing with WinGet, `uv self update`[^1] gave a confusing error message[^2] suggesting multiple versions of uv were installed. This is because the receipt wasn't removed, which I fixed by removing `%LOCALAPPDATA%/uv/uv-receipt.json` (well, all of `%LOCALAPPDATA%/uv/` actually).

Should the uninstallation instructions mention this?

[^1]: Yes, I know it doesn't work with WinGet.
[^2]: "The current executable is at ... but the standalone installer was used to install uv to ... Are multiple copies of uv installed?"

title: Remove receipt in uninstallation instructions
